user.title: Add a KeepSmile light
user.description: Select a discovered light and give it a name.

manual.title: Add a KeepSmile light manually
manual.description: No lights were discovered. Enter the Bluetooth MAC address (e.g. 23:01:02:98:1B:2B) and a name.

validate.title: Validate the light
validate.description: The light should have flicked on and off. Confirm you saw it, or retry the connection.

data.flicker: The light flicked on and off

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the light.
abort.cannot_validate: The light did not respond as expected.
